# Health checks

45 checks. A failed **MUST** rule is a *fail*, a failed **SHOULD** rule a *warning*; a check whose feature the agent's card does not declare is *not supported* and not counted.

## A · Discovery

| Check | Rule | Level | Spec | How to fix |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `A1.card_reachable` | The Agent Card is served | MUST | A2A §8.1, §8.2 | Serve the card at /.well-known/agent-card.json (or the configured card URL). |
| `A2.card_required_fields` | Required card fields are present | MUST | a2a.proto AgentCard (REQUIRED) | Fill in name, description, supportedInterfaces, version, capabilities, defaultInputModes, defaultOutputModes and skills. |
| `A3.card_interfaces` | Every interface declares URL, binding and version | MUST | A2A §8.3.1 | Give each supportedInterfaces entry its url, protocolBinding and protocolVersion. |
| `A4.card_skills` | Every skill has its required fields | MUST | a2a.proto AgentSkill (REQUIRED) | Give each skill an id, name, description and at least one tag. |
| `A5.card_signature` | Card signatures verify | MUST | A2A §8.4.3 | Sign the canonical card (RFC 8785) and publish the key at the JWS jku / JWKS. |
| `A6.card_caching` | The card is cacheable | SHOULD | A2A §8.6.1 | Send Cache-Control with a max-age and an ETag with the card. |
| `A7.extended_capability` | GetExtendedAgentCard matches the declared capability | MUST | A2A §3.3.4 | Declared: return the extended card or ExtendedAgentCardNotConfiguredError. Not declared: return UnsupportedOperationError. |

## B · Transports & versions

| Check | Rule | Level | Spec | How to fix |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `B1.interface_answers` | The interface answers A2A calls | MUST | A2A §5.2 | Serve the A2A binding at every URL listed in supportedInterfaces, or remove the entry. |
| `B2.interfaces_equivalent` | Bindings see the same tasks | MUST | A2A §5.1 | Serve every binding from the same task store and handler. |
| `B3.version_unsupported` | Unsupported A2A-Version is refused | MUST | A2A §3.6.2 | Return VersionNotSupportedError when the A2A-Version major version is not served. |

## C · Messaging

| Check | Rule | Level | Spec | How to fix |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `C1.send_shape` | SendMessage returns a Task or a Message | MUST | A2A §3.1.1 | Return a Task (for tracked work) or a Message. |
| `C2.send_blocking_state` | A blocking send waits for a final or interrupted state | MUST | A2A §3.2.2 | Without returnImmediately, return only when the task is terminal or needs input/auth. |
| `C3.context_generated` | The response carries the contextId | MUST | A2A §3.4.1 | Include the generated contextId in the Task or Message you return. |
| `C4.unknown_task` | Unknown taskId is refused | MUST | A2A §3.4.2 | Return TaskNotFoundError when a message names a task that does not exist. |
| `C5.context_task_mismatch` | Mismatching contextId and taskId are refused | MUST | A2A §3.4.3 | Reject a message whose contextId differs from its task's context. |
| `C6.terminal_task_message` | A finished task accepts no new message | MUST | A2A §3.1.1 | Return UnsupportedOperationError for messages to completed, failed, canceled or rejected tasks. |
| `C7.history_zero` | historyLength 0 omits history | SHOULD | A2A §3.2.4 | Omit Task.history when historyLength is 0. |

## E · Task lifecycle

| Check | Rule | Level | Spec | How to fix |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `E1.results_as_artifacts` | Results are returned as artifacts | SHOULD | A2A §3.7 | Return task output as artifacts; use messages for progress and questions. |

## F · Task operations

| Check | Rule | Level | Spec | How to fix |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `F1.get_task` | GetTask returns the task | MUST | A2A §3.1.3 | Return the stored task for its id. |
| `F2.get_unknown` | GetTask of an unknown id is TaskNotFoundError | MUST | A2A §3.1.3 | Return TaskNotFoundError for ids that do not exist. |
| `F3.get_history_length` | GetTask honours historyLength | MUST | A2A §3.2.4 | Never return more history messages than historyLength. |
| `F4.list_context_filter` | ListTasks honours the contextId filter | MUST | A2A §3.1.4, §13.1 | Return only the tasks of the given context. |
| `F5.list_next_page_token` | ListTasks always returns nextPageToken | MUST | A2A §3.1.4 | Always include nextPageToken; send "" on the last page. |
| `F6.list_artifacts_omitted` | ListTasks omits artifacts unless asked | MUST | A2A §3.1.4 | Leave the artifacts field out entirely when includeArtifacts is false. |
| `F7.list_order` | ListTasks returns the newest tasks first | MUST | A2A §3.1.4 | Sort by status timestamp, most recent first. |
| `F8.cancel_terminal` | Canceling a finished task is TaskNotCancelableError | MUST | A2A §3.1.5 | Return TaskNotCancelableError for completed, failed, canceled or rejected tasks. |
| `F9.cancel_unknown` | Canceling an unknown id is TaskNotFoundError | MUST | A2A §3.1.5 | Return TaskNotFoundError for ids that do not exist. |

## G · Streaming

| Check | Rule | Level | Spec | How to fix |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `G1.stream_capability` | Undeclared streaming is refused | MUST | A2A §3.3.4 | Return UnsupportedOperationError for SendStreamingMessage when streaming is not declared. |
| `G2.stream_first_event` | A stream begins with the Task (or is one Message) | MUST | A2A §3.1.2 | Send the Task first, then status and artifact updates; or exactly one Message. |
| `G3.stream_closes` | A stream closes when the task finishes | MUST | A2A §3.1.2 | Close the stream once the task reaches a terminal state. |
| `G4.subscribe_task_first` | SubscribeToTask sends the Task first | MUST | A2A §3.1.6 | Send the current Task as the first event of a subscription. |
| `G5.subscribe_terminal` | Subscribing to a finished task is refused | MUST | A2A §3.1.6 | Return UnsupportedOperationError when the task is already terminal. |

## H · Push notifications

| Check | Rule | Level | Spec | How to fix |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `H1.push_capability` | Undeclared push notifications are refused | MUST | A2A §3.3.4 | Return PushNotificationNotSupportedError for config calls when push is not declared. |
| `H2.push_crud` | Push configs can be created, read, listed and deleted | MUST | A2A §3.1.7–§3.1.10 | Store the config as sent and return it from Get and List until it is deleted. |
| `H3.push_delete_idempotent` | Deleting a push config is idempotent | MUST | A2A §3.1.10 | Deleting an already deleted config must succeed with the same effect. |
| `H4.push_delivery_auth` | Notifications carry the configured credentials | MUST | A2A §4.3.3 | Send the config's authentication as the Authorization header of every notification. |

## I · Security

| Check | Rule | Level | Spec | How to fix |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `I1.auth_rejects_anonymous` | Calls without credentials are rejected | MUST | A2A §7.4 | Authenticate every request against the schemes the card declares. |
| `I2.auth_rejects_wrong` | Calls with wrong credentials are rejected | MUST | A2A §7.4 | Validate the credentials, not just their presence. |
| `I3.auth_challenge` | A 401 says how to authenticate | SHOULD | A2A §3.3.2, §7.4 | Include a WWW-Authenticate header naming the scheme in 401 responses. |

## J · Extensions

| Check | Rule | Level | Spec | How to fix |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `J1.extension_required` | Required extensions are enforced | MUST | A2A §3.3.4 | Refuse requests that do not activate a required extension with ExtensionSupportRequiredError. |

## K · Errors

| Check | Rule | Level | Spec | How to fix |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `K1.errors_mapping` | A2A errors use the binding's error codes | MUST | A2A §5.4 | Map each A2A error to the JSON-RPC code, gRPC status and HTTP status in A2A §5.4. |
| `K2.errors_payload` | Error responses carry a code and a message | MUST | A2A §3.3.2, §5.4 | Return the error's code and a human-readable message (and ErrorInfo over HTTP+JSON). |

## L · Resilience

| Check | Rule | Level | Spec | How to fix |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `L1.resilience_resubscribe` | Resubscribing after a dropped stream returns the Task first | MUST | A2A §3.1.6, §3.5.2 | Answer SubscribeToTask with the current Task, then continue with live updates. |
| `L2.resilience_independent` | A task keeps running when its stream drops | MUST | A2A §3.5.2 | Do not cancel or fail a task because the client's stream disconnected. |
| `L3.resilience_multi_stream` | Several streams of one task receive the same updates | MUST | A2A §3.5.2 | Deliver every update of a task to each open stream for it. |
